# pavoz-extensions

> Official extension pack for pavoz: `@gate` (worker → multi-lens review → score → revise convergence loop) and `@schema` (cross-stage contract validation). Two plain decorators over stage functions — pavoz core needs no changes, and core never depends on this package.

Install (not on PyPI yet): `pip install "pavoz @ git+https://github.com/liyong-labs/pavoz@main"` then `pip install --no-deps git+https://github.com/liyong-labs/pavoz-extensions@main`

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md) · [README.cn.md](README.cn.md): what each decorator does, minimal usage, cost bounds
- [docs/PRD.md](docs/PRD.md): scope, requirements, success criteria, what is deliberately out of 0.1.0
- [docs/design.md](docs/design.md): `@gate` / `@schema` contracts, control flow, boundaries, CI design
- Source: `pavoz_extensions/gate.py`, `pavoz_extensions/schema.py`

## Rules that do not change

- **Public API only.** This pack may import only from the `pavoz` top level — `tools/check_public_api.py` enforces it in CI. `pavoz.runtime` / `pavoz.types` and friends are off-limits.
- **Core never depends on this pack.** Extensions pin a compatible range (`pavoz>=0.3,<0.4`).
- **Reviewers are ordinary callables.** No LLM (or any vendor) is assumed anywhere in the API; the tests run with plain functions.

## Before you commit

```bash
python -m pytest                          # all tests
python -m pyflakes pavoz_extensions tests tools
python tools/check_public_api.py          # only pavoz top-level imports
python tools/check_doc_links.py           # markdown links must resolve
python tools/check_doc_style.py           # doc style (clichés / versioned headings / punctuation)
```

Docs in this repo are for humans first: value up front, runnable example early, no dead links.
